forecasts.line: Kurzweil expects computers around 2010 to fade from view, built into clothing, furniture and surroundings.

works.author: Ray Kurzweil
works.title: The Singularity Is Near: When Humans Transcend Biology

forecasts.line: Kurzweil expects drugs that let people eat freely without putting on weight to reach patients between 2010 and 2015.

works.author: Ray Kurzweil
works.title: The Singularity Is Near: When Humans Transcend Biology

forecasts.line: Yudkowsky extrapolates that computers with the raw processing power some attribute to the human brain will appear around 2015.
Drexler's rough estimate put working molecular nanotechnology around 2015.
Bostrom expects supercomputers able to simulate every neuron individually to arrive between about 2015 and 2024.
forecasts.quote: we will have to wait until about 2015 or 2024

forecasts.line: Yudkowsky guesses that molecular nanotechnology will arrive by 2010 at the latest, ahead of earlier timetables.
forecasts.quote: My own guess would be no later than 2010.

forecasts.line: Yudkowsky claims to see a full path to the Singularity, probably reachable by 2010, and substantially sooner with heavy funding if the research problems prove tractable.
forecasts.quote: I think we could probably do it by 2010

forecasts.line: Moravec projected in 1988 that computer hardware able to support roughly human-level performance would exist by 2010.
Kurzweil expects supercomputers to reach the raw capacity of one human brain by 2010.
forecasts.quote: supercomputers will achieve one human brain capacity by 2010

works.author: Ray Kurzweil
works.title: The Singularity Is Near: When Humans Transcend Biology

forecasts.line: Kurzweil expects genomics and related biotechnology to lift life expectancy by more than a year for each passing year by 2011.
forecasts.quote: we will be adding more than a year every year within ten years

forecasts.line: Bostrom thinks the brain science required to build human-level AI could plausibly be in hand by 2012.
forecasts.quote: might be obtained in perhaps fifteen years from now, i.e. by year 2012

forecasts.line: Aubrey de Grey expects scientists to show robustly rejuvenated mice, functionally younger and longer lived, by 2015.

works.author: Ray Kurzweil
works.title: The Singularity Is Near: When Humans Transcend Biology

forecasts.line: Sandberg and Bostrom expect electron microscopes with around a thousand parallel beams, each at current speed, to be feasible by 2018.
forecasts.quote: appears reachable within the next ten years

forecasts.line: The Hinxton Group expected human eggs and sperm grown from stem cells to be available by 2018.
Kurzweil projects affordable hardware with human-level computing power by 2018, extrapolating the chip industry's own roadmap.

works.author: Ray Kurzweil
works.title: The Singularity Is Near: When Humans Transcend Biology

forecasts.line: Kurzweil projects that a thousand dollars will buy ten trillion bits of memory around 2018.

works.author: Ray Kurzweil
works.title: The Singularity Is Near: When Humans Transcend Biology

forecasts.line: Kurzweil expects the shrinking of transistors on flat chips to reach its limit by 2019, with three-dimensional molecular circuits taking over.
forecasts.quote: Moore’s Law will die a dignified death no later than the year 2019

works.author: Ray Kurzweil
works.title: The Singularity Is Near: When Humans Transcend Biology

forecasts.line: Kurzweil extrapolates supercomputers reaching the roughly brain-scale speed of ten quadrillion operations a second during the early 2010s.
